long_biography.plain_text:
Alabama developer Steve Ladas worked with an architect and engineer to reshape a proposed convenience store and filling station in Mobile. He presented revised plans with fewer fuel pumps and a smaller canopy. The building drew inspiration from a former structure designed by George B. Rogers, while Ladas proposed lighting designed to prevent spillover onto neighbouring properties.

His firm's Shoppes of Saraland development secured tenants before construction began. The completed centre accommodated a restaurant, an ice-cream business and a cookie shop, beside another property in its portfolio. Ladas was the named contact for leasing enquiries.
